_note: Default targets for a general healthy adult on a ~2000 kcal/day diet. These are educational reference points from public AHA/DASH guidance, not medical advice. Editable in Settings.

sodium.source: AHA: 2,300mg/day general upper limit; 1,500mg/day 'ideal' target for most adults, especially those with high blood pressure. Defaults to the general limit so healthy users aren't shown as constantly over.

saturatedFat.source: AHA: keep saturated fat to about 6% of total daily calories

addedSugar.source: AHA: no more than 36g/day (9 tsp) for men, 25g/day (6 tsp) for women. Defaults to the higher figure; adjust in Settings.

fiber.source: DASH 2000-kcal pattern / Dietary Guidelines for Americans

protein.source: General RDA reference (0.8g/kg body weight); adjust to your own needs in Settings
